entries.name: Alpha, o Lobo Branco
entries.description: The trail of this scent bears the unmistakable signature of Dracula, the Immortal King. When Dracula fell, he cursed the world of Vardoran with a blood rain, a scourge in which many perished. Some who survived became unknowingly twisted by the downpour, their bloodlines forever empowered by his malice. This mighty predator is infused with that legacy.

entries.name: Azariel the Sunbringer
entries.description: A true politician, Azariel wormed his way to the top of the ranks of the Church of Luminance with cold, calculated social grace. Few can match his power and dedication to the Light short of Solarus the Immaculate himself, and none within the church would dare contradict his word.

entries.name: Beatrice the Tailor
entries.description: The most talented tailor in all of Vardoran. Though the legacy of Dracula’s blood runs through her veins, she has proven far more charming than dangerous.

entries.name: Christina the Sun Priestess
entries.description: When the Church of Luminance first discovered the abilities granted by the blood rain, they took it as a blessing from the Light, incidentally masking the truth of Dracula’s influence. Christina is one such faithful servant of the church. This cruel disciplinarian takes her continued mastery of Light as evidence that her torturous methods of enforcing her beliefs are a necessary tenet of her faith, and she very much enjoys proving her righteousness.

entries.name: Clive the Firestarter
entries.description: An unparalleled genius in the explosive arts. Unfortunately for Grayson, this chaotic psychopath is far too useful to get rid of at providing and mixing destructive materials. He'll burn down his entire camp just to take you with him, laughing all the while.

entries.name: Drácula, o Rei Imortal
entries.description: When Dracula fell centuries ago, it seemed like the Church of Luminance had done the impossible. The death of the Immortal King. However, in his final moments, Dracula enacted his final gambit and cast a cloud over Vardoran. The blood rain that followed would plant the seeds of Dracula’s will across the realm, twisting it, and filling it with his storied essence. After death, the Immortal King’s soul was cast out to where his otherworldly powers originated, the Shadow Realm. There he lingered, biding his time. Now the time has come. Dracula floods the world with his monstrous Legion of Noctum, having them gather the blood necessary for him to become whole once more and return to Vardoran.

entries.name: Errol the Stonebreaker
entries.description: A brutal mining foreman, just as adept at crushing stone as he is crushing bone. Not even his incredible eye for recovering and refining metals was enough to stop him from getting run out of civilised society. His violent rage makes a fine motivator for the miners.

entries.name: Foulrot the Soultaker
entries.description: A mad cultist that claims to be the vessel of his decapitated horse, 'Foulrot the Soultaker.' He also claims his blades take their victims straight to 'The Great Darkness', an effort to feed or please some infernal power. Whether or not there's truth to his claims, his headcount is undeniable.

entries.name: Frostmaw the Mountain Terror
entries.description: An unspeakable horror that lurks in the snowy corridors of the Hallowed Mountains. Some say it used to be a simple woodsman. Most don't dare invoke its name at all.

entries.name: Gorecrusher the Behemoth
entries.description: Once a loyal warrior in the Legion of Noctum. So dedicated was his fanaticism that upon Dracula’s death to the hands of the Church of Luminance, the warrior severed his shield-bearing arm in an act of shame. In a delirious haze, he wandered into the wilderness of the Cursed Forest expecting to die. The corruption within gave him not death, however, but something much worse.

entries.name: Goreswine the Ravager
entries.description: A mad cultist, too far gone to be really intelligible. The Malevolent being they serve pushes them to desecrate all things, with little regard for practicality. They wear a rotting pig's head as a decorative mask.

entries.name: Grayson the Armourer
entries.description: The working arm and logistical mastermind of the bandit forces, Grayson is the backbone of their operation. As the quartermaster of a band of chaotic outlaws, murderers, and thieves, he's the stern voice of reason that keeps their gang well fed and well equipped.

entries.name: Iva
entries.description: Quando ativado, consome Drenagem de até {Count} alvos, curando a si mesmo em {Healing}% da sua vida máxima por alvo.

entries.name: Jade the Vampire Hunter
entries.description: A huntress from a noble house in Brighthaven, famous for their development of new-age weaponry that rivals even the genius of the scientists of Gloomrot. After the disappearance of her brother, rumor has it the expert marksman stole an impressive arsenal of experimental weapons to aid in her hunting down the culprit.

entries.name: Keely, a Arqueira do Gelo
entries.description: A cold-hearted bandit lieutenant, she oversees the animal husbandry and leather tanning camp in Farbane. Once a member of the Dunley militia, she was removed from her position for her brutal battlefield decision-making. Aside from being a crack shot, her enchanted arrows rain down icy death.

entries.name: Leandra the Shadow Priestess
entries.description: There are few creatures on the face of Vardoran as ancient as Leandra. Mysterious and surrounded with shadow magic and undeath, it is said that when Dracula fell, and the poisonous blood rains soaked Vardoran, she stood willingly in the deadly downpour. Some say she embraced the dark power of that corruption and made it her own. Today she serves as High Priestess of the Cult of the Damned.

entries.name: Lidia the Chaos Archer
entries.description: An adept but undisciplined archer, she lets her arrows fly and trusts that fate knows where to take them, and it works. Lidia is a force of chaos that cannot be contained, and the bandit king is happy to let her do as she likes as long as it benefits him.

entries.name: Mairwyn the Elementalist
entries.description: A dangerous spell-caster in tune with the most ephemeral qualities of nature. Mairwyn speaks to the winds, which whisper for change, chaos, and destruction. However, she seems content to only massacre those who wander too close to her Grove.

entries.name: Matka the Curse Weaver
entries.description: Some say Matka is the oldest of the witches, but the truth is nobody knows how or when these timeless creatures were born. A force of nature and a mockery of humanity, she is utterly beyond reason.

entries.name: Meredith the Bright Archer
entries.description: Meredith is a true believer in the Church of Luminance. She believes her power is a gift from the Light to wield against dark forces, much as the original Paladins were given the Light to strike down Dracula and the Vampire legions. As brave as she is naive to the Church’s descent into avarice and gluttony, this holy archer is blinded by the light, focused only on her pursuit of justice at any cost.

entries.name: Morian the Stormwing Matriarch
entries.description: The most dangerous of her kind, and fiercely protective of her tribe. It's said that the harpies are attracted to only the finest gemstones, and none has a sharper eye for quality than the matriarch herself. Wealthy folk are warned to keep their jewels out of sight if they dare travel outside the protection of Brighthaven.

entries.name: Nicholaus the Fallen
entries.description: A necromancer driven out of high society in Silverlight for his indulgence in the dark arts. Now he lives among the undead, using his unliving servants to fulfill his needs, as well as bring him back unwilling subjects for his experiments.

entries.name: Octavian the Militia Captain
entries.description: An old soldier and a veteran of many battles, Octavian is perhaps the most trusted man in all of Dunley. The militia serves him without question, and he in turn serves them to the best of his ability. Don't let his age fool you, he's got plenty of fight left in him.

entries.name: Polora the Feywalker
entries.description: A powerful psychopomp that taps into mysterious spiritual sources. Polora is one of the only known mortal links to fairy kind and driven to the brink of sanity by her intimate connection to nature. Her dream-like home is alive with unique, enchanted plant life.

entries.name: Quincey the Bandit King
entries.description: The 'King' of the bandits, once heralded as a hero of the common people in Dunley. His lack of proper reverence for the Church of Luminance saw him driven into Farbane, where his prowess in battle earned the respect of the banditry and, eventually, a place as their champion and king. He may have been a good man, once.

entries.name: Raziel the Shepherd
entries.description: The head and heart of the Dunley Monastery and a true believer in the Light, Raziel is known for his persuasive sermons and harsh, fire-and-brimstone rhetoric. It is believed that his holy power is granted by his incredible righteousness, largely because he keeps saying so.

entries.name: Rufus the Foreman
entries.description: A lieutenant of the bandit forces charged with looking over the logging camp. Just because he's an expert woodworker doesn't mean he doesn't know his way around a crossbow, though. He didn't rise up in the bandit ranks for nothing.

entries.name: Solarus, o Imaculado
entries.description: A legendary paladin of the Light and the oldest living member of the Church of Luminance. He has watched firsthand the descent of mankind with disinterest. A pioneer from the age of heroes, he remembers the struggle of facing down Dracula’s armies until all hope was lost. He remembers finding the light... He remembers the satisfaction of lifting his holy blade to the Immortal King, and striking down the greatest evil the world has ever seen. He yearns to return to the days where he knew glory.

entries.name: Sommelier
entries.description: Antigamente um espadachim mercenário viajante, o bom barão ganhou o título de Grande Sommelier após vencer um concurso de degustação organizado pela Igreja da Luminância. Dizem que suas habilidades extraordinárias permitem que ele identifique os ingredientes, idades e lugares de origem de qualquer bebida com apenas um gole. Embora sua nova posição lhe ofereça todas as riquezas materiais que deseja, aqueles que o conhecem bem acreditam que sua maior saudade é o sabor do sangue na ponta de sua espada.

entries.name: Terah the Geomancer
entries.description: The result of a long line of earth speakers, Terah resides up in the solitude of the mountains among sparkling gem veins and rugged boulders. Despite her stoic appearance and demeanour, communing with the spirits of nature has driven her quite insane.

entries.name: Terrorclaw the Ogre
entries.description: A creature whose story has long since been lost to the ages, thought not without resemblance to some few legendary creatures that were once men. One cannot help but wonder what strange corruption has taken root in Vardoran.

entries.name: Tristan, o Caçador de Vampiros
entries.description: A cold-blooded killer, and the scion of a long line of vampire hunters. Few are as prepared to face the rising tide of vampire threat as Tristan, and his drive to exterminate the last of the unholy threat is second to none.

entries.name: Ungora the Spider Queen
entries.description: A massive spider of legendary age and progeny. The Spider Queen resides in the twisted, web-woven depths of Cursed Forest's winding caverns. No living creature save for her children has ever entered and lived to tell the tale.

entries.name: Vincent, o Portador do Gelo
entries.description: A stalwart champion of law and order in Dunley, it's his mission to protect the common people with his chilling gifts. Some say his methods have been getting more harsh and violent ever since his sister was banished.

entries.name: Essência de Sangue
entries.description: Uma fonte de energia extraída do sangue. Vampiros usam a essência para controlar materiais, desbloquear conhecimentos secretos e transformar humanos em servos obedientes.

entries.name: Essência de Sangue Primordial
entries.description: Uma fonte de energia extraída do sangue. Vampiros usam a essência para controlar materiais, desbloquear conhecimentos secretos e transformar humanos em servos obedientes. É produzida em uma Prensa de Sangue Avançada.

entries.name: V Rising
entries.description: Eu quero que meus dados sejam usados para análise e para ajudar no desenvolvimento de V Rising

entries.description: Tier 4 Jewel

entries.name: Aftershock
entries.description: Smash the ground, causing a shockwave that erupts, dealing 140% magic damage in a line and inflicting .

entries.name: Arctic Leap
entries.description: Leap into the air and strike down at target location, dealing 250% magic damage. A nova of frost erupts from the impact location that s any enemy hit for up to 6s. Enemy vampires are for 2s.

entries.name: Army Of The Dead
entries.description: Inflict on nearby enemies and summon an army of 6 skeleton warriors and 2 skeleton mages around you. Skeletons last for up to 7s.

entries.name: Carrion Swarm
entries.description: Summon 4 blood bats in a line that attacks towards your target location. Each bat pierces enemies dealing 30% magic damage and inflicting . Allows you to recast the ability to spawn anotherswarm within 2s.

entries.name: Chaos Barrage
entries.description: Launch 4 Chaos projectiles that deal 200% magic damage on direct hit, 100% magic damage to enemies in an area and inflicts .

entries.name: Chaos Barrier
entries.description: Block melee and projectile attacks in front of you for 2s. Blocking an attack charges the barrier up to 5 times. Unleash a chaos bolt dealing 50% magic damage and inflicting when the effect ends. The projectile deals 40% additional damage per charge. Recast during the effect to launch the projectile early.

entries.name: Chaos Volley
entries.description: Launch 2 Chaos Bolts in a sequence that deals 125% magic damage and inflicts .

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.description: Block melee and projectile attacks for 1.5s. Blocking an attack triggers an ice nova that deals 50% magic damage and inflicts a 2s . Gain a shield absorbing up to 50% of your spell power for 4s when this effect triggers.

entries.name: Crimson Beam
entries.description: Channel a beam of energy that deals 275% magic damage and inflicts to enemies hit while healing allies for 200% of your spell power per second for up to 3s. Each target hit heals self for 75% of your spell power.

entries.name: Crystal Lance
entries.description: Launch a projectile dealing 170% magic damage and inflicting lasting 4s.

entries.name: Curse
entries.description: Conjure 5 wisps in a cone inflicting and . reduces movement speed by 25% for 3.5s and 40% of damage taken during the effect is dealt as additional damage when the curse ends. May deal up to a maximum of 500% damage. Each enemy hit by the wisps grants .

entries.name: Cyclone
entries.description: Conjure a cyclone that pierces enemies dealing 120% magic damage and inflicting . The cyclone returns after reaching max distance, granting . circle around you, dealing 20% magic damage and inflicting . Effect stacks up to 3 times.

entries.name: Death Knight
entries.description: Summon a Death Knight at target location that attacks nearby enemies. Each swing deals 50% magic damage in an area and inflicts . The Death Knight lasts for 6s.

entries.name: Discharge
entries.description: Block melee and projectile attacks for up to 1.5s. Blocking an attack pulls the target toward you and grants one . Enemies triggering Discharge in close vicinity are stunned for 0.6s. circle around you, dealing 20% magic damage and inflicting . Effect stacks up to 3 times.

entries.name: Eye Of The Storm
entries.description: Knockback nearby enemies and conjure a thunderstorm around you. Lightning bolts strike down in the surrounding area dealing 100% magic damage and inflicts . The storm rages on for 5s and lightning strikes the area 37 times over the duration.

entries.name: Frost Barrier
entries.description: Block melee and projectile attacks in front of you for 2s. Conjures up to 8 frost spikes dealing 50% magic damage and inflicting when the barrier is struck. Recast during the effect to conjure a cone of cold dealing 25% magical damage and inflicting .

entries.name: Fúria de Sangue
entries.description: Heal nearby allies for 65% of your spell power and apply a fading haste that increases movement speed by 10% and attack speed by 25% for 3s. Inflicts on nearby enemies.

entries.name: Heart Strike
entries.description: Dash forward and strike enemies in a line. Deals 150% magic damage and heals self for 150% of your spell power over 3.5s. A nova of blood erupts when the effect ends dealing 150% magic damage and inflicting to the victim and nearby enemies.

entries.name: Ice Block
entries.description: Turn target ally or self into solid ice for up to 5s and summon a frost vortex. The ice block shields target for 500% of your spell power, grants immunity to crowd control effects and heals up to 10% of target maximum health. The vortex initially deals 150% magic damage and inflicts . The vortex deals 240% additional damage over the duration of the effect.

entries.name: Ice Nova
entries.description: Conjure a nova of ice at the target location dealing 150% magic damage. The nova radiates outward inflicting . Hitting a enemy s it for 4s.

entries.name: Lightning Tendrils
entries.description: Launch 6 Lightning Bolts in a sequence that deals 40% magic damage each and inflicts .

entries.name: Mist Trance
entries.description: Block melee and projectile attacks for up to 1.5s. Turn immaterial and teleport to cursor location when an attack is blocked. Inflicts on nearby enemies when reappearing and grants for each enemy hit.

entries.name: Phantom Aegis
entries.description: Apply a shield to target ally or self that shields the target for 170% of your spell power, inflicts on nearby enemies and grants for each enemy hit. The shield lasts up to 2s.

entries.name: Power Surge
entries.description: Boost a target ally or self applying a fading haste that increases movement speed by 15%, attack speed by 20% and physical attacks inflict for 3s.

entries.name: Raging Tempest
entries.description: Dash forward and bounce between nearby enemies striking them for a total of 525% magic damage split across targets within the area over 3s. Additionally strikes all enemies in the area up to 4 times dealing 50% magic damage and inflicting . Afterward, dash towards your aim direction. Attack to end this effect early.

entries.name: Rito de Sangue
entries.description: Block melee and projectile attacks for 1.5s. Blocking an attack triggers a blood nova that pushes enemies away and dealing 60% magic damage and inflicting . Turn immaterial for 1.2s when this effect triggers.

entries.name: Sanguine Coil
entries.description: Launch a projectile that deals 80% magic damage, drains 30% health and inflicts . Heals ally hit for 120% and self for 30% of your spell power.

entries.name: Soulburn
entries.description: Drain the life from up to 3 nearby enemies dealing 60% magic damage, leeching 100% health, interrupting attacks and inflicting .

entries.name: Spectral Guardian
entries.description: *Upon being summoned, the Spectral Guardian will knock back nearby enemies in the area. *The Spectral Guadian swings roughly every 2 seconds, for a total of 3 swings per summon. In Update 1.1 the Spectral Guardian's damage was increased from 100% to 150%.

entries.name: Spectral Wolf
entries.description: In 1.0 Hotfix #6, this spell's damage was increased from 125% to 140%. In 1.0 Hotfix #9 this spell's jewel "number of bonus bounces" modifier was increased from 1 to 2. In Update 1.1 this spell's damage was increased from 140% to 150%. In the 1.1 October patch it was changed in the following ways: *Cast time reduced to 0.6s from 0.7s. *Movement penalty during cast reduced to 40% from 50%. *Projectile velocity increased to 22 from 20.

entries.name: Tempestade de Sangue
entries.description: Become invulnerable and channel a Blood Storm for 3s, launching up to 25 homing blood bolts at nearby enemies. Each bolt deals 100% magic damage and inflicts . End with a powerful nova, dealing 300% magic damage and pushing enemies away.

entries.name: Unholy Chains
entries.description: Launch a chain that shackles the target hit reducing movement speed by 10%-40% based on distance to the target. Channel the spell for up to 1.7s. Deals 280% magic damage and inflicts when the effect ends. The bond breaks and inflicts a 2s fading snare if the distance between yourself and the target exceeds 14 meters.

entries.name: Void
entries.description: Summon an orb that explodes at the target location, dealing 80% magic damage, inflicting and pulls enemies towards the center.

entries.name: Véu das Sombras
entries.description: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for 2.2s. Your next primary attack heals you 5% of your maximum health.

entries.name: Véu de Sangue
entries.description: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for 2.2s. Your next primary attack heals you for 5% of your maximum health and triggers a nova of blood that deals 20% magic damage, drains 20% health and inflicts .

entries.name: Wraith Spear
entries.description: Dash towards input direction and launch a piercing projectile dealing 170% magic damage and inflicting . Each subsequent hit deals 75% damage of the previous hit and grants .
